component_decisions.reason: The current corpus scope is Siraya with aligned English and Mandarin references. Historical Dutch OCR is unreliable and is not treated as reviewed corpus data.
The corpus unit is the numbered printed verse. Headings remain recoverable from the retained page ranges and are not sentence records.
The OCR layer is a locator aid only. Rendered scan pages control source review.
Current authority has no Siraya standard orthography and no fos phonology profile.
The source is parallel verse text, not interlinear glossed data, and supplies no word or morpheme analysis.
